About This Game

It's a simple race around a board. Until someone starts playing chess.

Welcome to Yutnori, a traditional Korean board game where you toss sticks and race your pieces to the finish.

Sounds simple, right?

Except you can poop all over the board.
Or win by getting beaten up by every other player.
Or turn your opponent’s best ability into a useless cat.
Or just... cancel someone else’s win.

With 90 game-changing augments, things can get out of hand pretty quickly. Combine bizarre rules, pull off ridiculous strategies, and find new ways to win every match!

Key Features

  • 2–10 Player Online Multiplayer — Play with friends or strangers.

  • Turn-based strategy — Turn-based strategy built on traditional Korean Yutnori.

  • 90 Unique Augments — Discover different combinations every match.

  • Quick Match & Private Lobbies — Jump into a game or create your own room.

  • Anything Can Happen — Special pieces, traps, changing boards, and alternative win conditions.
